english.title: Goods vehicle operator carry commercial goods between member states fail to comply with posting enquiry
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[between member States,]_

english.legislation: Contrary to regulations23(2) and 27(1)(b)and (6) of the Goods Vehicles (International Road Transport Permits and Haulage Within the EU) Regulations 2024.
